Ushio.why: Sells lithography equipment for advanced packaging and package substrates (UX-5 steppers, direct imaging lithography, DLT maskless systems); AI-server substrate and advanced-packaging demand drives its orders.
Ushio.evidence: Ushio 3M FY2026 results presentation (08-04-2026): 'In PCB substrates, demand for thick and heavy substrate applications centered on AI servers is increasing'; 'Adoption progressing at major substrate manufacturers'.

players.product: Lithography equipment for advanced packaging and package substrates: UX-5 steppers, direct imaging (DI) lithography equipment and DLT maskless lithography systems

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2026 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 3M FY2026 (April-June 2026): net sales JPY 48.9 billion (+27.7%), operating profit JPY 4.9 billion (+410.5%), above the internal plan. Industrial Processes sales 20.5 billion yen (+29.9%); lithography equipment sales 3.6 vs 3.8 (-5.3%) as stepper sales declined on the timing of customer acceptance; increased demand for lithography equipment led to a reversal of valuation losses (+JPY 1.0 billion).
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 48.9 billion (+27.7%); lithography equipment sales JPY 3.6 billion (-5.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2026 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lithography equipment for advanced packaging: UX-5 stepper orders and inquiries are increasing, reflecting a focus on mass-production stability, supporting sales expansion from the next fiscal year; adoption is progressing at major substrate manufacturers. DLT systems: informal approval of adoption for mass-production use obtained from some customers (new), with increased earnings contribution expected from FY2027 and full-scale mass-production adoption from FY2028 onward. DI lithography: demand for thick and heavy PCB substrates centered on AI servers is increasing, and demand for high-density package substrates is rising with optical modules.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2026 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ushio's DLT system (with Applied Materials) is a maskless digital-micromirror lithography tool for advanced substrates: resolution 1μm to 5μm, overlay ±0.35μm, maximum substrate size 510mm×515mm.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results presentation: Financial Results for the First Three Months of FY2026 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year to March 2027) forecast unchanged: net sales JPY 210.0 billion (+17.2%), operating profit JPY 14.0 billion; Industrial Processes sales 92.5 billion yen. Lithography equipment sales are expected to grow in the second half (H2 weighted); the company says forecasts are under review for uncertainties such as material costs and geopolitical risks.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 210.0 billion; operating profit JPY 14.0 billion
